quests.title: Yian Kut-Ku Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Today you will
battle a Yian Kut-Ku. Its
weakness is its sensitivity
to loud noises. Try a Sonic
Bomb or even a Barrel-Bomb!

quests.title: Congalala Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Today you will
battle a Congalala. If you
are hit by something it has
thrown, the smell will spoil
your items and you won't be
able to use them!

quests.title: Khezu Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Today you will
battle a Khezu. You must
fear not only its electric
attacks but also its roar.
Thus, equip a weapon guard
and be ready to use it.

quests.title: Daimyo Hermitaur Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Today you will
battle a Daimyo Hermitaur.
Supposedly you can only
crack its shell with a
Hammer or Hunting Horn, but
a Lance works as well!

quests.title: Blangonga Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Today you will
battle a Blangonga. You may
even become a Snowman!
The best escape is using a
Thawing Agent... Or hitting
the beast on its arms!

quests.title: Yian Garuga Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Today you will
battle a Yian Garuga. After
threatening you, Garuga
likes to let off a roar or
two. When you sense a
threat, prepare yourself!

quests.title: Tigrex Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Today you will
battle a Tigrex. Tigrex will
come after you with all its
got, so don't just wait
around. Jump into the fight!

quests.title: Diablos Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Today you will
battle a Diablos. When it's
on the defensive, a Sonic
Bomb is useful, but once
it's mad, that won't do a
thing, so use a Flash Bomb!

quests.title: Gravios Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Today you will
battle a Gravios. When
fighting underneath it,
beware of being crushed!
When it's airborne, choose
your spots! Don't mess up!

quests.title: Kirin Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Today you will
battle a Kirin. The key to
this battle is lightning. If
you can detect its patterns,
you can increase your
chances of victory!

quests.title: Cephadrome Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Time to face a
Cephadrome! Aim to use Small
Barrel-Bombs when it is
hiding. Set the bomb where
it will resurface! That's
the secret!

quests.title: Plesioth Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Time to face a
Plesioth! Chasing it when it
changes areas is easy, but
you'll have to figure out a
way to fish it out of the
ground.

quests.title: Shogun Ceanataur Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Time to face a
Shogun Ceanataur! If it
extends its claws, that's
your cue to pay attention
because its reach has
doubled! Get out of the way!

quests.title: Rathalos Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Time to face a
Rathalos! You'll need a
Paintball to keep track of
it when it takes to flight,
so make sure you hit it
before it gets away!

quests.title: Rajang Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. So you've made
it this far, huh!? I'm
speechless! Let's see what
you've got! Show me your
true strength on this 
mountain!

quests.title: Blue Yian Kut-Ku Exercises
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. If you can clear
this Group Training in time,
your reward will explode!
Faster! Smarter! Set a new
record!

quests.title: Cephadrome Exercises
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. An all out
assault will only lower your
time marginally. Victory
rests on what you have and
what you can combine it with
in the southern desert.

quests.title: Rathian Exercises
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. No time for
tricks, just use your skills
and finish this beast off!
Use everything you've
learned about "cooperation"
and obliterate your foe!

quests.title: Congalala Exercises
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. I want to see
your true power on this one!
Give it all you've got, you
hear!? But don't leave your
friends in the dust. Be as
one! Fight as one!

quests.title: Shogun Ceanataur Exercises
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Your opponent
this time is a pair of
Shogun Ceanataurs. You only
have to beat one to clear
the quest, so remember which
one you're going after!

quests.title: Tigrex Exercises
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. You'll be going
after 2 Tigrex back to
back today. Try not to
attack when it's infuriated,
and use whatever you've got
to create an opening!
